paper_id: HypomimiaCoach_ An AU-based Digital Therapy System for Hypomimia Detection & Rehabilitation with Parkinson's Disease
title: HypomimiaCoach: An AU-based Digital Therapy System for Hypomimia Detection & Rehabilitation with Parkinson's Disease
motivation: 当前临床 hypomimia 诊断依赖主观经验且康复缺乏可及的数字化工具,患者就医受限
problem_framing: 把 hypomimia 的检测与康复重新定义为基于 AU 的可量化闭环系统问题
key_insight: AU 不是独立特征而是相互关联的系统,用 GCN 建模 AU 关系可提升检测性能
method_signature: 检测: Swin Transformer+GCN+CNN; 康复: OpenGraphAU 实时反馈+中国戏曲音乐交互
evaluation_criteria: 检测: Accuracy/PPV/TPR/F1; 康复: 可用性/参与度/自我效能
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 小样本(7例)限制结论泛化性,数据量(105样本)不足以充分训练模型
evidence_for_taste: relies heavily on the subjective expertise of neurologists
bridging the gap between technological advancements and clinical rehabilitation practice remains a challenge
small sample size is a limitation in itself
lack of real-time feedback and quantitative assessment mechanisms
thinking_moves: 将检测与康复合并为一个闭环数字疗法系统,而非分开解决
通过迁移学习缓解小样本 hypomimia 数据稀缺问题
用自我决定理论解释患者依从性动机的底层需求(自主/关联/胜任)
借助中国戏曲的音韵和文化熟悉度提升患者康复参与度
